description: SpectralStabilizer.constructor(SpectralToken,AutonomousTreasury,ISpectralEntropyOracle,address,address,uint256,uint256,address[]) (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#237-291) has external calls inside a loop: v == address(0) || IERC4626(v).asset() != reserveAsset (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#259)
triage: accepted: Constructor only, bounded by MAX_ALLOWED_VAULTS = 4: it checks each allowlisted vault's asset().

description:
Reentrancy in SpectralStabilizer.redeem(uint256,address,uint256) (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#342-366):
	External calls:
	- _syncLossWith(reserveValue()) (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#348)
		- token.setIndex(newIndex) (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#567)
	- token.burn(msg.sender,amount) (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#361)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- _releaseExpansion(amount) (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#362)
		- mintedInEpoch = used - amount.toUint128() (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#588)
		- mintedInEpoch = 0.toUint128() (src/SpectralStabilizer.sol#588)
triage: accepted: nonReentrant on the entry point; the calls go to the immutable token and treasury (and allowlisted vaults through it); the state written afterwards is the caller's own accounting.
